requiredFindings.title: A failed end-path reserve still owes REV
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Step 0 says a reserve that cannot be taken refuses on the budget row and that no StoppedSession then owes an append. Item 3's closing sentence says a refusal at any step returns a StoppedSession which still holds the end-path reserve. Item 6 finishes every outcome. Item 7 appends one REV when the gate is latched, and the observer may already have latched, which is why the reserve is first. The only append exception is an uncertain journal commit or barrier. A failed reserve with a latched gate still owes the REV, and the session does not hold the reserve that would fund it. Required: a failed step-0 reserve is the budget row, and finish appends neither REV nor CLN. The reserve-holding sentence applies to a refusal after the reserve was taken. A latched gate with no reserve releases and runs the end step, and appends nothing.

requiredFindings.title: An uncertain journal outcome still copies the floor
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 4 and item 7 leave reconciliation of an uncertain journal commit or barrier to the next opener, and item 7 still runs X3b item 4's end step on every finish. That end step reads a committed tail and copies the floor forward when the tail is higher. X3b r6 item 5 requires this writer to refuse every further effect, reconcile by reopening the carrier and running reconcile_witness, and assume neither state. A QUARANTINE outcome leaves the floor untouched. A floor copy from an unreconciled read can record a tail the witness does not confirm. Required: finish appends nothing. While the lease is still held, this writer reopens the carrier and runs reconcile_witness. The floor copy runs only after that reconciliation returns OK, REVERT, or ADVANCE. A QUARANTINE outcome leaves the floor untouched. The uncertain path still rolls back the open ledger transaction and releases level 4 once.

scope: Law X3d r2. r1 RF-1 through RF-5 are closed. RF-1: a failed end-path reserve appends nothing. RF-2: an uncertain journal outcome reconciles before any floor copy. No product cargo.
